subject: mathematics
concept: Finding the mode (most common value) in a small data set
source_inspiration: adapted from Singapore CPA sequencing principles — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student groups virtual objects by category and identifies the tallest group
exercise.pictorial: Student circles the tallest bar/most frequent icon set on a pictured graph
exercise.abstract: Student identifies the mode from a written list of data values

misconception_flags: confuses mode (most frequent) with the largest individual value

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
